## Purpose
`Activity.tsx`'s `ActivitySection` and `Sessions.tsx`'s `SessionSection` are page-local (not exported) interfaces that hold one grouped bucket of rows for rendering as a collapsible/labelled section. Both pages group a flat `SessionRow[]` by a derived key (work `kind`/`category`) via a `Map<string, SessionRow[]>`, then convert the map into an ordered array of these Section objects with a fixed priority-ordered key sequence and an always-last fallback bucket for the ungrouped/null case. `Knowledge.tsx` groups its rows too but does not need a named Section type — it works directly off the sorted `[string, KnowledgeRow[]]` tuple array, since it needs no display `label` beyond the raw kind key. Two of the three exemplars declare the Section shape; treat it as the pattern for pages that need a human LABEL per bucket, not a universal requirement for every grouped page.

## Convention
Folder: apps/dashboard/src/pages/** · Extension: .tsx · Files of this role in this subproject: 3
Where declared, the interface is `interface <Page>Section { key: string; label: string; sessions: T[]; }` — a stable bucket `key` (used for React `key` and priority lookups), a human-facing `label` (resolved via `t()`/a lookup table, not the raw key), and the bucket's rows. It is NOT exported (page-local only) and is built by a page-local `group<By>` function that: buckets into a `Map`, sorts within each bucket, then sorts the bucket keys using a fixed `PRIORITY_ORDER` array with unlisted keys falling back to alphabetical-by-label and a sentinel null-bucket key always sorted last.

## How to apply
Add a page-local, non-exported `interface <Page>Section { key: string; label: string; rows: T[] }` (adjust the rows field name to the domain) only when the page renders labelled/orderable groups of a list. Pair it with a `group<By>(data, ...)` function following the bucket→sort-within→sort-keys shape shown in `Activity.tsx`/`Sessions.tsx`, using a `PRIORITY_ORDER` array plus a `NULL_BUCKET` sentinel for the fallback group. If the page only needs the kind key as its label (no separate human string), a plain sorted tuple array (as in `Knowledge.tsx`) is sufficient and a Section interface is unnecessary overhead.
